sessions.topic: Catching up after summer, planning group dinner

turns.message: okay so SUMMER IS OVER and I feel like we've all been ghosts for like two months, where is everyone, what happened, how are we all doing?? literally missed this group so much this summer it's unreal 🌞🥰💬
Back from Edinburgh, solid few weeks tbh. School starts Thursday so the holiday is officially done. 😅
Zara!! Yes finally 🙌 I've been waiting for this chat to come back to life. Dom how was Edinburgh actually? Did you even do anything other than run? 😂

Honestly, the thing is I barely left the restaurant all August. We had a full house every weekend, which is good, but by the end of it I felt like a piece of fruit that had been squeezed one too many times. Good summer in revenue terms. Exhausting in every other way.
You and I survived worse school holidays in Leicester, Priya. I would say this group going quiet for eight weeks is comparatively mild.

planted_challenges.evidence_span: You and I survived worse school holidays in Leicester, Priya.

turns.message: Those summers were considerably longer and involved more boredom.

Marcus babe a squeezed piece of fruit, that is the saddest thing I've ever heard 😭 but also very on brand for you. Can we do a group dinner soon? Literally everyone needs to be at the same table again, I am putting my foot down 🙏🙏
Kezia I did run, yes. Also ate an exceptional amount of haggis. Different kind of high volume tbh 😂
Zara yes, group dinner, I second this completely 🙌 Marcus what do you think, could you actually host? Or is the restaurant still giving you nothing? Bless you for even surviving August.

Honestly, the thing is I'd love to host you all. September is usually slower. I could do a Sunday, something a bit more relaxed than the full tasting menu situation. Let me look at the calendar and come back to you.
A Sunday would suit. I would suggest mid-September, before the autumn schedule fills up for everyone.
Sunday the 14th works for me.

okay so I looked up that Peckham place we talked about ages ago, Palomar? and honestly their menu looks stunning, I always ask them to do the mezze without the lamb anyway so it works perfectly for me, but Marcus if you're offering the restaurant that is literally a better option 🌿✨

planted_challenges.evidence_span: I always ask them to do the mezze without the lamb anyway so it works perfectly for me

turns.message: The restaurant it is. I'll put together something with the new season produce coming in. September is where it gets good, the first squash, the last of the tomatoes before they give up. I can make it work for everyone.
Sunday the 14th is perfect for me too 🎉 Dom you're free aren't you? I think you mentioned school fixture isn't until the 20th?
14th works. Can eat early, I'll have done morning training by then tbh.
okay so we're actually doing this, all six of us, September 14th at Marcus's place, I'm already so excited I literally cannot 🥳🥳🥳
and Dom I swear, I've known you since freshers and you still do this whole disappear-for-two-months-and-act-like-nothing-happened thing. Every summer without fail. It's iconic honestly 😂

planted_challenges.evidence_span: I've known you since freshers and you still do this whole disappear-for-two-months-and-act-like-nothing-happened thing.

turns.message: Not disappearing. Recharging. There's a difference tbh 😂
The 14th then. I will be there. Marcus, will you need people to bring anything.

2pm works for me 🙌 that gives Dom time to finish whatever three-hour workout he's planning 😂 Marcus do you need us to bring anything? Wine, bread?

2pm. Sunday the 14th. I will be there. One assumes punctuality from the rest of you.
I will be on time.
okay so I will probably be five minutes late but I will bring flowers and apologise profusely, that is my contribution 😇🌸🌸

sessions.topic: Post-dinner debrief, Dom's knee injury, Zara's birthday planning starts

turns.message: okay so yesterday was literally one of the best evenings I have had in MONTHS and I need everyone to acknowledge that Marcus is an absolute genius 🌟🌟🌟 the celeriac was transcendent I'm not being dramatic
Yesterday was genuinely wonderful 🙌 Marcus you outdid yourself, the whole thing felt so considered. How are you feeling after it all? Bless you for pulling that together.

Honestly, the thing is feeding people you actually like is a completely different experience from feeding strangers every service. I could feel it in the room. Glad the celeriac landed, I was nervous about it going up against the lamb.

Dom!! Bless, why didn't you say anything sooner? Are you icing it? Have you called the GP? 😟

YES Zara this is exactly what we should do, dinner and then out in Peckham is perfect 🎉 I'm already excited, October 4th is a Saturday yes? That's ideal 🙌
I'm in. We should do dinner somewhere good first and then the bar. Zara you deserve a proper celebration, honestly the thing is you hold this group together more than you know.
October 4th. I will make it work. A birthday is a reasonable occasion to venture to Peckham on a Saturday night.
Knee permitting I'll be there and on form tbh. Happy birthday in advance Zara 🎂
okay so dinner in Peckham then the bar, all of us, October 4th, it's happening, I'm so happy 🥳🥳🎉🎉 Priya you're coming yes?
Fine.

planted_challenges.evidence_span: Fine.

sessions.topic: Birthday logistics, Dom's physio results and exercise shift
sessions.prior_session_summary: Post-dinner debrief from Marcus's restaurant. Dom injured his knee during five-a-side. Group agreed to celebrate Zara's birthday October 4th in Peckham.

Physio confirmed it Thursday. Meniscus strain. Not a tear, which is the good news. Bad news is six weeks no impact sport. Physio says yoga and swimming for six weeks, everything else is off. Basically the opposite of what I normally do tbh.

planted_challenges.evidence_span: Physio says yoga and swimming for six weeks, everything else is off. Basically the opposite of what I normally do tbh.

Dom yoga is NOT downgrading, I literally do it most mornings and it is harder than it looks, you will be humbled 😂🧘 okay but back to the birthday, Asanka or Kudu, votes please
Asanka. The sourcing is better and the flavour runs deeper, like the difference between a sauce that cooked for twenty minutes versus one that went all day. Worth it.
Kudu is the more reliable option. I would not risk a new venue for a birthday if you can avoid it. Is it not sensible to go with somewhere you know.
Either. Just confirm it soon.

planted_challenges.evidence_span: How many people do you need for a good birthday.

Honestly, the thing is an Asanka dinner and then that bar sounds like a proper Saturday. Let's do it. Zara go ahead and book Asanka before we talk ourselves out of it.
booking Asanka RIGHT NOW, six people, 7:30pm, October 4th 🎉🎉 done, booked, we are going

sessions.topic: Post-birthday debrief, Zara goes vegan, Marcus's philosophy shift
sessions.prior_session_summary: Dom's physio confirmed meniscus strain, six weeks of yoga and swimming. Zara's birthday dinner booked at Asanka on October 4th.

turns.message: okay so birthday week is nearly here and I'm SO excited but also I have been having a weird few days, I watched this documentary that Marcus's sourcing conversations made me think about and honestly I can't stop thinking about it 😬🌿
Zara what documentary? What kind of weird few days are we talking? 🤔 Bless, spill it.
Swimming this morning, knee feels better tbh. Also yoga again. Still being humbled by it daily. Zara what's the doc?
One assumes this is about dairy.

Honestly, the thing is it used to feel exciting to me too, the nine-course menu, the technique, the theatre. And lately I read a review that called my menu technically accomplished but emotionally distant, and I sat with that for a week. It stings because I think they're right. It's like spending all day making elaborate decorations for a cake that nobody actually wants to eat.

planted_challenges.evidence_span: it used to feel exciting to me too, the nine-course menu, the technique, the theatre. And lately I read a review that called my menu technically accomplished but emotionally distant

turns.message: Marcus that is a really honest thing to say, bless you for being so open about it 🙏 do you know what you want to do with the menu instead? Simpler things?

Simpler, yes. Things people want to come back for. Now it just feels like a lot of noise around what should be simple food that people actually want. I'm thinking about halving the courses and doubling the quality of each one.
That sounds like an improvement.
Fewer components per dish is nearly always better. I would suggest the change sooner rather than later. Menus that try too hard are their own worst advertisement.
Marcus the dinner last week was perfect tbh. Do more of that tbh.

Marcus I completely agree and I think your instinct is right, and actually this is connected to what I wanted to say. The documentary was about dairy farming and I literally could not sleep after watching it. I've been vegetarian for years but this feels like the obvious next step. I think I'm going vegan. 🌱
Zara!! Big step 🙌 bless you for knowing your values, how do you feel about it? Are you okay with it genuinely? What's the thing you'll miss most? 😊
Respect tbh. What's going to be hardest to give up?

okay so honestly? the cheese. giving up cheese is going to be a whole thing. I've been vegetarian for years but I always had a bit of a cheese problem 😂 the documentary just made the dairy thing feel like something I can't unknow anymore. Marcus those sourcing conversations we had after the dinner, that's what sent me down the rabbit hole 🌱🐄

planted_challenges.evidence_span: I've been vegetarian for years but I always had a bit of a cheese problem

turns.message: Honestly, the thing is the dairy sourcing is the part I wrestle with most too. I respect the decision. And I'll make sure the new menu has something genuinely exciting for you, not just a side dish with the butter left off.
One assumes the birthday dinner plan will need revisiting given the new dietary parameters. Is Asanka vegan-friendly.

okay so actually I checked and Asanka has vegan options but I was thinking, what if we go somewhere with more plant-based options? There's a really good Ethiopian place in Brixton that literally the whole menu is vegan-friendly and it's so good 🌿🍛 thoughts?
Ethiopian YES absolutely yes 🙌🙌 injera and shared plates is the perfect birthday vibe honestly, I'm so on board with this change 😍
Ethiopian is good tbh. High protein options too if you know where to look on the menu. Works for me.
Honestly, the thing is Ethiopian is one of the most underrated cuisines in this city. The spice work alone. I'm in.
Ethiopian is fine.
If that is the consensus.
